propositions: Reconciler transport parameters lack type annotations, preventing mypy from enforcing port interface completeness
Importing port types through the unresolvable rebar_reconciler.* path causes mypy to silently widen annotations to Any, defeating static checking

Capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map) declared as metaclass attributes are invisible to mypy's protocol attribute collection, creating blind spots the AST audit cannot detect

Relative imports from ._backend restore mypy's ability to resolve and enforce TicketTransport annotations within reconciler modules, while the metaclass remains load-bearing for runtime isinstance honesty
The mypy ratchet alone (disallow_untyped_defs) cannot prevent this defect because Any annotations satisfy the strictness rule while remaining type-blind at port boundaries
